note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #29, Q3 2024 Family Violence) keeps INEGI columns bp4_3_1..bp4_3_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0924.csv (import delimited case(lower)), sets code 9 to missing (lines 241-246) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q3 data dictionary labels each BP4_3_k column 'Situacion vivida: <situation k>' and the label text is the printed situation k of question 4.3 (6/6 agree in content); catalogos bp4_3_1..6 give 1=Si, 2=No, 9=No sabe / no responde, identical to the printed codes. Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered Q3 questionnaire wording, not the dictionary labels, which differ from the print in two places: situation 3's dictionary label omits 'pellizcado,' (printed: 'por ejemplo, pellizcado, jalado el cabello, ...'), and situation 6's label reads 'obligarte' where the print reads 'obligarle'; the print is shipped in both cases (confirmed on a 110-dpi render of p.6). All 9 distinct Spanish strings shipped (CP3, CP4, 4.3 stem, 6 situations) are exact substrings of the pdftotext -raw output after whitespace normalisation; options Si/No as printed. Structure (batch_678 convention): one section_id; instructions = the two read-aloud blocks that precede 4.3, CP3 (Section IV introduction, p.5) then CP4 (p.6), joined with a space -- questions 4.1 (household screener, Tarjeta D) and 4.2 (were victims under 18) are printed between them and are not in this table; section_prompt = the 4.3 stem; item_text = the six situations. 4.3 is asked of every respondent (4.1 codes 2/9 'PASE A 4.3', code 1 continues via 4.2 to 4.3), so no routing shapes these items. Kept as printed: leading question marks, '(a)' gender fill in 'correrlo(a)', parenthetical examples. Stripped: situation numbers 1.-6., question number 4.3, entry boxes, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'D' Y REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; the note to ask 4.4/4.5 for code-1 situations and to skip to 5.1 when all are 2/9). Follow-ups 4.4 (who did it, Tarjeta E) and 4.5 (month) are not in the table. Tarjeta D itself is not in the questionnaire zip; item wording is from the questionnaire's own 4.3 grid. Options: 1=Si, 2=No (print and catalogo); 9 'No sabe / no responde' set missing by the .do, no row. Both levels used by every item. Cross-check (route 9 style, .cache/mexico_2024_q3safety_violence/counts.R): raw Q3 CSV 24096 rows, no blanks on any bp4_3 item; live 144521 rows over 24087 ids, 0 duplicate id-item; all 12 item x level counts identical raw vs live -- bp4_3_1 1/2 = 1184/22903, bp4_3_2 456/23631, bp4_3_3 364/23723, bp4_3_4 193/23894, bp4_3_5 290/23797, bp4_3_6 69/24017; code 9 = 9/9/9/9/9/10; 9 respondents have no 1/2 on any item (live ids 24087 = 24096 - 9). Step 3b: live items are exactly the six situations of question 4.3 (Seccion IV. Relaciones familiares) -- the only bp4_3_* columns in the Q3 file. The dictionary Description ('Self-reported exposure to and experience with violent crime') mislabels them: 4.3 asks whether the respondent experienced each situation WITH ONE OR MORE PEOPLE IN THEIR HOUSEHOLD (intra-household / family violence, as the .do's own 'Family Violence' bookmark and INEGI's section title say), and two of the six (humiliation; being thrown out of or threatened with eviction from the home) are not violent crime. Dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q3 wave (file suffix 0924) -- same defect as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), all fresh -- no earlier quarter has this section. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section IV question 4.3 from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, and added an English translation of its own; the items ask about situations the respondent experienced with members of their own household, not violent crime in general; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
